name: 4D Hyper-Slice
description: Raymarched 3D cross-section MRI scan through 4D 600-cell and 120-cell polychora via H4 Coxeter domain folding.

parameters.name: Slice Offset
parameters.description: Position of the 3D cutting hyperplane along the W-axis (MRI scan cross-section sweep).

parameters.name: Rotate XW
parameters.description: Primary 4D hyper-rotation through the XW plane (continuous inside-out polyhedron morphing).

parameters.name: Rotate YW
parameters.description: Secondary 4D hyper-rotation through the YW plane.

parameters.name: Rotate ZW
parameters.description: Tertiary 4D hyper-rotation through the ZW plane.

parameters.name: Rotate X
parameters.description: 3D Pitch rotation of the cross-section solid.

parameters.name: Rotate Y
parameters.description: 3D Yaw rotation of the cross-section solid.

parameters.name: Rotate Z
parameters.description: 3D Roll rotation of the cross-section solid.

parameters.name: Support H
parameters.description: Facet radius / support plane distance in 4D fundamental chamber.

parameters.name: Color Method
parameters.description: 0 = H4 Chamber Sector, 1 = 4D Radial Depth, 2 = 3D Surface Normal Spectrum.

parameters.name: Opacity
parameters.description: Face transparency for translucent crystal interior reveal.

parameters.name: Edge Thickness
parameters.description: Thickness of surface ridge crease highlights.

parameters.name: Edge Brightness
parameters.description: Brightness of ridge lines and facet boundaries.
